source: Baseball Savant (Statcast) leaderboards, MLB Stats API awards and minor-league stats, and MLB Pipeline prospect rankings, 2015-2026

definitions.hitter: A first true breakout season: 400+ PA with wOBA 30+ points above league (about 120 wRC+), 30 HR, or an All-Star / Silver Slugger / ROY-level honor.
definitions.pitcher: A first true breakout season: 100+ IP with ERA and xERA 0.6+ runs better than league, 200 K, an elite relief season (50+ IP, 20%+ K-BB), or an All-Star / Cy Young / ROY-level honor.
definitions.eligibility: Excludes anyone who has already broken out: an above-average full season, a big partial season, 30 HR, 180 K, +10 OAA, elite relief work or 20 saves, a dominant half, or an All-Star, Gold Glove, Silver Slugger, ROY or Players Choice honor. Hitters 30 or younger, pitchers 31 or younger.
definitions.prospects: Ranked MLB Pipeline prospects (Top 100 or an org Top 30) with under 100 MLB PA / 15 MLB IP in 2026. Same breakout bar, in their first real MLB season.
